blocks.text: Questions live in the question bank. Get there from the Questions menu or Create Questions on the portal home.

blocks.title: Tag every question with at least one category
blocks.text: An untagged question is invisible to category reporting. Use the Add or Remove Category button while writing, or bulk-tag from the questions table.

blocks.title: Apply tags, but leave the tree alone
blocks.text: The category tree is shared across all courses and about nine years of data. Renaming or moving a node changes what past reports mean. If your course needs a new category, ask OME to add it.

blocks.title: Embed images you need on the printed backup
blocks.text: OME prints two hard copies of every exam. Attached images do not appear on the printout. If students need to see the image to answer the question, embed it.
A group keeps related questions together when the assessment is randomized. Use it for clinical scenarios where several questions reference the same stem.

items: While creating a question, type a group name in the Group field.
Give every question in the vignette the same group name (case-sensitive).
When questions are added to an assessment, grouped questions stick together.

blocks.title: Verify group order before posting
blocks.text: Grouped questions appear in the order they are listed on the assessment. Confirm the sequence is correct before handing off to OME.

blocks.title: One blank per question
blocks.text: For accurate scoring and reporting, limit Fill in the Blank and Matching questions to a single blank or match per question.

items: Pick rectangle or polygon first. Polygon is better for irregular structures.
Drag the image onto the question. GIF, JPG, and PNG all work.
Drag to outline the correct region. Students can pinch to zoom on the iPad.

blocks.title: Drag and Drop does not score sequence
blocks.text: Order makes no difference to the score. If you need sequence scored, use Ordering instead.

blocks.title: Partial credit subtracts points
blocks.text: Students gain points for correct answers dragged in and lose the same for wrong ones (floor is 0). Warn them in the stem.
